text: Bulgarian white brined cheese is made with a starter containing Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus and ripened in brine for 45–60 days, which gives it its specific lactic-acid taste (pH 4.2–4.4) and moderately salty flavour.

steps.note: The curd is shaped in cloth into blocks of 100–220 × 100–110 × 80–100 mm.
The cheese is put into brine, or dry-salted in layers instead.
The cheese is ripened in a 6–10 % brine, for 45 days in cow's or goat's milk, otherwise 60.
